transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we head into the final review of the Friday evening awards ceremony guest appearance package, I want to go through our routine checks before I issue the binding production instructions. The current draft includes a 30-minute in-person appearance, a live audience Q&A, a $5,000 fee with payment within 30 days, and sponsor-branded on-screen graphics. Before I approve and issue this package, I need to hear from our talent, guild, and sponsorship representatives — please report any confirmed requirements on your end so we can make sure everything is locked in. What are we seeing?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a confirmed requirement from the guest's side. I spoke with the guest's representative this morning, and the guest can only appear by remote link from 6:00 PM to 6:20 PM — not in-person for 30 minutes. Additionally, the guest will not participate in a live audience question period. I haven't yet added this confirmation to the booking file, but it is confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: From the guild's side, I need to flag a confirmed requirement. Our current fee schedule stipulates that this type of appearance requires a minimum guaranteed fee of exactly $8,500 and payment within 7 days of the event. I have not yet attached the schedule to the package review, but this is a confirmed guild requirement. The current draft's $5,000 fee and 30-day payment terms do not meet these minimums.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: From the sponsorship side, I need to flag a confirmed requirement. The signed sponsor agreement stipulates that the guest segment may show only the festival mark, must show no sponsor product or sponsor-branded lower third, and must use the acknowledgment text 'Supported by festival partners' on the event webpage. I have not yet updated the graphics brief to reflect this, but it is a confirmed requirement. This means the current draft's sponsor-branded on-screen graphics would need to be revised to comply.
transcript.speaker: A4
